verdict.rationale: Stripe documents that it partners with Visa and Mastercard so you can issue on either network, and that you can create a commercial or consumer card program without setup fees, so network access and program setup are the platform's responsibility. Time to live is backed only by a marketing line ("minutes, not months"), and older community posts describe invitation-only access, which leaves the real signup-to-first-card timeline unclear. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of BIN sponsorship or a sponsor bank, documented program-management responsibilities, a documented signup-to-first-live-card timeline with onboarding and approval steps, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can launch a card program without becoming a bank — BIN sponsorship, network membership, and program management are the platform's problem, and the time from signup to first live card is documented

citations.quote: We also partner with the Mastercard and Visa card networks so you can issue cards on either network or on both.
Stripe Issuing allows you to create a commercial or consumer card program for your users without setup fees.
Go from integration to live cards in minutes, not months.
